research.question: Does a pointer-only chart pick need a keyboard path; do 5.7 px dots with a 27 px active column meet target-size guidance; is an SVG alternative that repeats adjacent text correct?
research.reason: The brief's open question and two normative claims behind UX-3, UX-8 and UX-10.

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.1.1 Keyboard (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: All functionality operable through a keyboard interface (Level A); a comparable keyboard alternative elsewhere conforms; pointer-only handlers alone fail (F54).

sources.title: Understanding SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: 24x24 CSS px (AA) with exceptions including essential dense data visualisations; enlarge the active area.

sources.title: Understanding SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content (WCAG 2.2)
sources.claim: A short alternative serving the equivalent purpose; adjacent text may carry the information.

research.summary: A keyboard path is required or an equivalent elsewhere; the dots fall under the dense-data exception; the alternative should say what the drawing adds.
research.limitations: Normative standards, not population research; WebView text scaling (UX-12) not researched.
